name: Apply two exact hunks to a CRLF file
description: Read src/settings.cfg, then use one edit.patch call with the fs.read revision and two hunks: change mode=legacy to mode=strict and timeout=30 to timeout=45. Preserve every other byte and the existing line-ending style. Do not rewrite the whole file.
expected_edit: one revision-checked edit.patch with two hunks, preserving CRLF
